routines.title: Review stalled checkouts and generate recovery outreach
routines.text: Review recent abandoned checkouts and shopping bags. Draft helpful, stylish follow-up recovery emails offering customer sizing help and the 10% discount code SUNNY10.

routines.title: Weekly conversion and sales performance summary
routines.text: Review weekly store order trends, best-selling product categories (dresses, knitwear, suits), average order value, and plan conversion targets for the coming week.
